summary:
Source for #4801 (unmerged at capture) reads Claude Code transcript JSONL through the existing usage and passive paths without a new wire schema: `telemetry usage collect claude --session-file` uses the Codex --turn-id/--all-responses/--since/--until contract, and a fsgg.telemetry.passive-selection/1 file naming claudeHome feeds provider-usage-observation/1 with provenance claude-local-transcript/1 and identity namespace claude-transcript/1. The legacy --snapshot input stays; nothing produces it by default.

Measured on one host, Claude Code 2.1.299 (shape only; no transcript content retained): usage repeats per content block. The main-thread writer emits only completed records (stop_reason set) with identical usage. The subagent writer streams; per-block records carry stop_reason null and provisional output_tokens without thinking_tokens before one completed record, and 11 of 17 message ids disagreed. Deduplicate on completed records only, and refuse when completed repeats disagree. A response with no completed record is withheld and makes later totals in its turn unknown, never zero. Every user record, including tool results, carries promptId. Assistant records do not, so turn_id is the promptId of the nearest preceding user record at completion; this agreed with parentUuid resolution for all 209 measured records. In a subagent transcript promptId tracks the session's current prompt rather than the subagent task. Subagent transcripts were observed at <session>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl beside a .meta.json, sharing the parent sessionId with isSidechain true and agentId. Readers take an explicit file and give each sidechain a derived version-8 thread identity; the path is an observation, not a contract. The passive cursor retains the prompt context so resumed passes attribute like a full read; its digest excludes per-block timestamps so identical repeats are not corrections.

Unknown: whether status-line payloads still carry prompt_id/timestamp; older transcripts lacking promptId, isSidechain or agentId fail closed. --since/--until compare timestamps ordinally, so 05:01:30.000Z sorts before 05:01:30Z, as with Codex. Receiver admission of the new provenance needs a Host built from this source. Installed adoption, Host ingestion and display remain with #4640.
title: Claude Code native usage comes from completed transcript records, not status-line snapshots
